_comment: UNAUDITED-ARC(119): entPhysicalVendorType.1 in this part answers an OID under 1.3.6.1.4.1.119. nl6#821 typed that column as an OBJECT IDENTIFIER, so the value reaches the wire as an identity claim. The arc itself IS checked: TestEveryProfileServesOnlyItsOwnVendorArc requires nec_ix3315.json to serve PEN 119 and no other vendor's number. The value below the number has not been read against any NEC MIB. Refs nl6#590, nl6#821.
